\[
\langle E_k \rangle = \frac{3}{5}E_F .
\]

Given \(E_F = 7\;\text{eV}\),

\[
\langle E_k \rangle = \frac{3}{5}\times 7\;\text{eV}=4.2\;\text{eV}.

\[
4.2\;\text{eV} = 4.2 \times 1.602\times10^{-19}\,\text{J}
               \approx 6.73\times10^{-19}\,\text{J}.
\]

For a free electron the kinetic energy is \(\frac12 m v^2\). Solving for the speed \(v\),

\[
v = \sqrt{\frac{2\langle E_k\rangle}{m_e}}
   = \sqrt{\frac{2(6.73\times10^{-19}\,\text{J})}{9.11\times10^{-31}\,\text{kg}}}
   \approx 1.21\times10^{6}\;\text{m/s}.
\]

This matches option (B).

**The answer is (B)**.
